description:
Theres a kind of adventurous serenity to the 2023 Rivian R1S Adventure like an expedition vehicle that took a design degree, learned good manners, and then decided to go anywhere. It has the stance of something built for real terrain, but it wears that capability with clean, modern confidence rather than brute-force swagger. Tall, upright, and unmistakably purposeful, the R1S looks ready to leave the pavement behind while still feeling at home in a downtown parking garage. Its the rare SUV that can look equally natural next to a trailhead, a charging station, or a minimalist home with very expensive landscaping.

From the outside, the design feels fresh and almost architectural. The signature light elements give it an instantly recognizable face one that feels futuristic without drifting into gimmickry. The body is smooth and tightly composed, with surfaces that seem designed by wind itself: clean lines, rounded corners, and a shape that balances utility with elegance. Theres no excess here, no decorative noise. Every surface seems to serve a purpose, and that purpose happens to look striking. Its the sort of vehicle that makes rugged feel polished.

Step inside and the R1S Adventure turns into a modern outpost. The cabin feels open, airy, and intentionally calm, with a design language that favors clarity over clutter. Materials feel thoughtful and upscale, but not fussy more outdoorsy luxury than city-bound opulence. The seating is arranged to make the whole space feel flexible and welcoming, like a well-planned base camp that happens to be upholstered. Theres an easy sense of usefulness to everything: storage, layout, sightlines, controls. It feels built for people who actually do things, not just talk about doing them.

Behind the wheel, the R1S brings a very particular kind of excitement the silent kind that hits immediately and then keeps building. Acceleration feels instant and effortless, giving the SUV a surprising sense of eagerness for something so substantial. It moves with the confidence of a vehicle that knows exactly how much torque it has available, and it deploys it with smooth precision. On-road, it feels composed and stable, off-road, it feels like its barely waking up. The whole experience is equal parts calm and capability, with the kind of control that makes difficult terrain feel less intimidating.

What really defines the R1S Adventure, though, is the way it blends utility and imagination. Its practical in the best possible way spacious, adaptable, and ready for family life, road trips, gear hauling, or spontaneous detours into the unknown. Yet it never feels purely utilitarian. Theres a sense of curiosity embedded in its personality, as though it expects the owner to use it for something interesting.

In short, the 2023 Rivian R1S Adventure is modern exploration made tangible an SUV that feels smart, capable, and ready for whatever comes next. It doesnt just suggest adventure, it looks like its already packed.

The Absolute Sovereign of Super Duty: 2024 Ford F-250 King Ranch 4WD
Unite heavy-duty workforce capability with legendary Texas luxury. This 2024 Ford F-250 Super Duty King Ranch is a One-Owner, Clean CARFAX recent arrival engineered to conquer the toughest jobs while surrounding you in world-class executive comfort. Showcasing the majestic and highly refined Bronze Metallic exterior over a magnificent Java Leather cabin, this four-wheel-drive (4WD) Crew Cab comes completely loaded with the brute muscle of the 6.7L Power Stroke® Turbodiesel, the rugged FX4 Off-Road Package, and the factory-integrated 5th Wheel/Gooseneck Hitch Prep Package.

The Power Stroke® Diesel Benchmark
Beneath the broad, sculpted hood lies the absolute gold standard in heavy-duty towing performance, delivering relentless linear pulling power.

6.7L Power Stroke V8 Turbodiesel: Blasting out an incredible 475 horsepower and a frame-twisting 1,050 lb-ft of torque, ensuring massive loads feel entirely weightless behind you.

TorqShift® 10-Speed Automatic: Precision-engineered to manage the diesel's monumental torque profile, optimizing gear splits, engine braking, and open-highway fuel range.

5th Wheel/Gooseneck Hitch Prep Package: Factory-integrated bed mounting pucks and a bedside 7-pin connector ensure your heavy-duty trailer connects seamlessly and securely.

F-250 >10K GVWR Package: Upgrades core structural and mechanical parameters to comfortably manage increased payload demands and maximize legal trailering stability.

King Ranch Cabin: Texas-Class Luxury
Step inside an executive environment explicitly crafted to honor the heritage of the American West, replacing basic finishes with rich, tier-one textures.

Exclusive Java Leather Interior: Impeccably finished full-grain leather captain's chairs featuring the iconic King Ranch running "W" brand stitched directly into the seatbacks and center console.

Climate-Controlled Seating Matrix: Travel in absolute comfort with Heated & Ventilated Front Seats, Heated Rear Outboard Seats, and a heated leather steering wheel.

Twin Panel Power Moonroof: A sweeping panoramic glass roof that stretches over both rows, opening the expansive Crew Cab up to natural Texas sunlight.

B&O® Unleashed Sound System by Bang & Olufsen: An ultra-premium, stadium-grade surround sound system that floods the sound-insulated acoustic cabin with crisp highs and deep, punchy bass.

Next-Gen Digital Command Center
SYNC® 4 w/ Enhanced Voice Recognition: Features a massive, highly responsive high-definition center touchscreen display with native wireless smartphone integration.

Connected Navigation System: Includes cloud-connected mapping algorithms that provide real-time traffic alerts and custom trailer-routing parameters.

Exterior Parking Camera Rear w/ Brake Assist: Provides high-resolution visibility behind this heavy-duty titan, making solo trailer hookups and tight maneuvering completely stress-free.

FX4 Off-Road Armor & Chrome Accents
FX4 Off-Road Package: Preps the truck for rugged ranch paths and construction sites with Off-Road Specifically Tuned Shock Absorbers, underbody skid plates, and Hill Descent Control.

Premium Chrome Package: Instantly elevates the truck's exterior profile with stunning 20" Chrome PVD Aluminum Wheels, unique chrome mirror caps, chrome door handles, and a polished chrome exhaust tip.

The Covert Commitment
Serving Central Texas and beyond since 1909, the Covert family has spent over a century building an impeccable multi-generational legacy of trust, transparency, and top-tier guest care. Visit us at 11750 Research Blvd Suite B, Austin, TX 78759 to experience the "Covert Commitment" firsthand and see how this fully maximized 2024 Ford F-250 King Ranch upgrades your workforce and travel standards.

Why BUY from DeFouw Chevrolet? When you choose this Agate Black Metallic 2025 Ford F-150 LARIAT with 14,363 miles, you are not just buying a used vehicle - you are investing in quality, reliability and peace of mind. Our clientele depend on us for Transparent Pricing, Convenience and, most importantly, Customer FIRST Service! No Accidents! What this vehicle includes: Convenience
  • GPS linked cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until GPS linked cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed and the system uses GPS navigation data to maintain that speed without driver intervention - including slowing down for curves and anticipating hills. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Meet your ultimate co-pilot, GPS linked cruise control.
  • Unresponsive driver assistant - a reaction to inaction. Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.
Safety and Security
  • Hands-off cruise control with lane change - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now with hands-off cruise control with lane change simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles with minimal steering input from you. It slows you down, speeds you up, and helps you make lane changes. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-off cruise control with lane change.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
Technology and Telematics
  • SYNC 4 AppLink/Apple CarPlay/Android Auto smart device wireless mirroring

2023 Toyota Tundra Hybrid CrewMax TRD Pro Pickup 4D 5 1/2 ft Gallery Portfolio Technical Specification

The 2023 Toyota Tundra Hybrid CrewMax TRD Pro represents the absolute pinnacle of Toyota's modern full-size truck engineering. Completely abandoning the traditional V8 layout, this generation introduces a high-tech electrified powertrain combined with twin-turbocharging, resetting the benchmarks for its segment. The expansive CrewMax cabin paired with the functional 5.5-foot short bed forms a vehicle that serves equally as a prestigious executive daily driver and a professional-grade off-road weapon.

At the heart of this machine lies the i-FORCE MAX 3.4-liter Twin-Turbo V6 Hybrid engine. By placing an electric motor-generator directly between the engine and a highly responsive 10-speed automatic transmission, Toyota generates a massive 437 horsepower and a staggering 583 lb-ft of torque at a low 2,400 RPM. This hybrid setup is engineered specifically to eliminate turbo lag via instant electric torque assist. It allows this full-size truck to rocket from 0 to 60 mph in just 5.7 seconds while fully supporting a robust maximum towing capacity of up to 11,175 lbs.

The driving dynamics are anchored by professional, race-bred suspension hardware built to withstand punishing terrain. The TRD Pro comes standard with premium 2.5-inch FOX internal bypass shocks with piggyback reservoirs, delivering a 1.1-inch front lift straight from the factory. Replacing the traditional rear leaf springs of previous generations, a sophisticated multi-link coil-spring rear suspension setup keeps the truck remarkably flat and secure through fast pavement corners. Off-road, this architecture provides incredible wheel travel and high-speed dampening, working in unison with the Multi-Terrain Select (MTS) system and an Electronic Locking Rear Differential to conquer severe terrain with absolute ease.

On the exterior, the TRD Pro commands immediate attention with an aggressive, industrial design language. The front end is dominated by a bold heritage grille featuring integrated LED light bars and a classic TOYOTA script. The body features unique technical-camouflage patterned fender flares, a TRD Pro stamped aluminum hood, and dual black exhaust tips exiting the rear. Rolling stock consists of ultra-lightweight 18-inch matte-black forged BBS alloy wheels wrapped in aggressive Falken WILDPEAK all-terrain tires. The truck bed itself is constructed from a high-strength, lightweight aluminum-reinforced composite that naturally prevents rust, dents, and corrosion.

Inside, the cabin completely moves away from utilitarian work-truck roots, offering a premium digital sanctuary lined with motorsport details:

  • Technical camo-patterned SofTex -trimmed sport seats with bold TRD Pro embroidery, featuring 8-way power adjustments, heating, and ventilation

  • A massive, class-leading 14-inch Toyota Audio Multimedia horizontal touchscreen with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto

  • A crisp 12.3-inch fully digital driver instrument cluster featuring custom TRD startup animations

  • An immersive 12-speaker JBL Premium Audio System with an integrated factory subwoofer

  • A unique leather-wrapped TRD red-striped steering wheel and a matching red TRD engine start button

Practicality is prioritized across the expansive CrewMax cabin, which provides an incredible 41.6 inches of rear legroom ensuring adult passengers can stretch out in complete comfort on long cross-country journeys. The rear seats flip up to reveal a convenient under-seat storage tray, perfect for keeping valuable tools or recovery equipment safely locked out of sight. A signature, fan-favorite feature is the power vertical-sliding rear window, which allows the entire back glass to drop down completely, flooding the cabin with fresh air and making it simple to monitor cargo or load long items directly into the interior.

Fuel economy is highly optimized through the advanced hybrid architecture, achieving an EPA-estimated 18 MPG city / 20 MPG highway. Combined with a generous 32.2-gallon fuel tank, this brute serves as a premier long-distance overland cruiser, providing a massive driving range that minimizes time-wasting stops at the fuel pumps and lets you explore deeper into the wild with total confidence.

Safety is world-class, coming standard with the Toyota Safety Sense 2.5 suite. This comprehensive network of driver aids acts as an extra set of eyes on the road, featuring a Pre-Collision System with Pedestrian Detection, Lane Departure Alert with Steering Assist, Lane Tracing Assist, Automatic High Beams, and Full-Speed Range Dynamic Radar Cruise Control. Standard Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert and a Multi-Terrain Monitor with panoramic view cameras give you complete 360-degree visibility, making parking decks or narrow off-road trails entirely stress-free.

The 2023 Toyota Tundra Hybrid CrewMax TRD Pro is an absolute powerhouse that successfully blends high-end digital luxury, devastating low-end torque, and legendary off-road engineering into a single, cohesive statement of success. It is the perfect addition to our gallery portfolio, tailored for the professional who demands an elite, indestructible truck that is ready to tackle any challenge.

Dominant. Electrified. Unstoppable. ??
